title: Screen Translator Internal Inventory
description: Screen Translator internal inventory. Lists each visual unit detected in the legacy, with stable identity and traceability to source code. Saved in reversa/sdd/screens/inventory.json. Overwritten with each run.

sourcePlatform.description: Slug of the detected source platform (for example: cobol-ansi-tui, delphi-vcl, asp-classic, android-xml, ios-xib).

screens.description: List of screens detected in legacy.

id.description: Unique and stable identifier within this inventory (ex: SCR-0001).

canonicalName.description: Canonical screen name used in target_screens.md.

file.description: Relative path of the legacy file.

paragraph.description: Nome do paragrafo COBOL, do form Delphi/VB6, da Activity Android, etc.

kind.description: Structural type of the screen. Use 'raw' when the adapter does not cover the type.

isCritical.description: Marks critical vs auxiliary screens (powered by reversa-detective when available). In hybrid mode, critical screens tend to go to literal.

matchesUiInventory.description: true if the screen appears in reversa/sdd/ui/inventory.md.

uiInventoryRef.description: Corresponding line or anchor in reversa/sdd/ui/inventory.md.

transitions.description: Next screens or events triggered from this one.

i18n.description: When the screen has an external string catalog.

skipped.description: When the legacy has no UI, this field is filled and screens[] is empty.

divergenceFromUiInventory.description: Comparison against reversa/sdd/ui/inventory.md. If divergencePercent > 10, the agent stops and requests review (RF-05).
